headlines.title: Trump Secretly Switched Planes in Turkey Amid Reported Threat
headlines.description: Following the NATO summit in Turkey in July, President Donald Trump was seen boarding a decoy Air Force One. The Washington Post reports that after boarding the plane, he was whisked away to a nearby aircraft using a catering truck. The ruse was reportedly used to conceal his whereabouts amid an ongoing assassination threat from Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Keir Simmons
headlines.description: A multinational maritime coalition was recently formed to secure international trade routes throughout the Middle East.

headlines.title: All Eyes on Key Midterm Primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota
headlines.description: Voters are heading to the polls in another round of competitive primary races in the build-up to November’s midterm elections. In Wisconsin and Minnesota, Democrats will once again decide between moderate and progressive candidates. Meanwhile, in South Carolina, Republicans will pick a replacement nominee for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs chooses former Republican as running mate in re-election bid
headlines.description: Democratic Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs has chosen a former Republican as her running mate for her re-election bid this November.

headlines.title: Search Underway After Deadly 7.4 Earthquake Strikes Colombia
headlines.description: An urgent search for survivors is underway in Colombia after a powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake took many by surprise Monday morning. Rescuers are desperately digging through mountains of rubble to find those trapped inside buildings, as the death toll climbs to more than 130 people. NBC’s George Solis reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Ex-Marine freed from Russian prison after Trump discussed case with Putin
headlines.description: A former U.S. Marine who spent more than four years in a Russian prison and is believed to be seriously ill has been released and was on his way back to the United States. President Donald Trump announced the release of Robert Gilman after he discussed the case with Russian President Vladimir Putin. NBC News' Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: The most dramatic meteor shower of the summer peaks the day of a solar eclipse
headlines.description: The Perseids’ peak coincides with another highly anticipated celestial event: a total solar eclipse that will be visible in parts of Europe.

headlines.title: Trump Signs Executive Order on Childhood Vaccine Schedule
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has issued a new executive order calling for an overhaul of the childhood vaccine schedule that would reduce the number of vaccines kids receive, citing unsubstantiated claims. Critics are blasting the move, saying misinformation could mislead parents. NBC’s Nikki Battiste reports and NBC medical contributor Dr. John Torres joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Trump’s ICE crackdown returns to the spotlight as the midterms loom: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into the perilous immigration politics facing the Trump administration and the GOP. Plus, we preview the key races to watch as primary results roll in this evening.

headlines.title: Lucy Davis, ‘The Office’ and ‘Shaun of the Dead’ actor, announces incurable cancer
headlines.description: Lucy Davis, who played Dawn Tinsley in the British version of “The Office” and had a starring role in “Shaun of the Dead,” said she incurable cancer.

headlines.title: Family of NYC fashion designer found dead on Montauk boat to file wrongful death lawsuit
headlines.description: The family of a New York City fashion designer found dead on a boat in the Hamptons last year is preparing to file a wrongful death lawsuit against the man she was with when she died.
